question: Should Twilio RCS become a bundled OpenClaw channel, or remain an externally maintained channel plugin distributed through ClawHub?
rationale: The capability fits existing channel-plugin seams, while VISION.md favors external ownership for optional commercial integrations; only maintainers can sponsor the higher-security and long-term ownership commitment of bundling it.

options.title: Use an external RCS plugin
options.body: Keep core lean and publish the channel through ClawHub with its own package, permissions, secrets, install/update docs, example usage, and live smoke proof.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled channel
options.body: Accept core ownership only after the Twilio contracts, dependency gate, SMS compatibility impact, security review, merge conflicts, and live-provider proof are resolved.

recommendation.title: Use an external RCS plugin
recommendation.body: Keep core lean and publish the channel through ClawHub with its own package, permissions, secrets, install/update docs, example usage, and live smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The bundled Twilio SMS channel and its ownership precedent originate from this person's merged work, making them the strongest available product-routing candidate.
